evidence_snippets: For example, the following functions match the string "hello world": SEARCH("hello world") SEARCH("Hello World") SEARCH("HELLO WORLD") Because backticks are used in the following functions, they produce different results: SEARCH("hello world") SEARCH("world hello") The Logging query language supports different ways that you can search your log data.
